output.summary: The 95% green dashboard is unreliable. It is self-reported with no objective criteria, and its green share rose from 64% to 91% in the weeks after the Nov 2025 memo. 25% of variable pay is tied to percent-green. Audit found 4 of 6 green projects behind baseline, and 5 of 7 escalations came from projects that were green. CSD's Platform requests are late and under-specified: 58% are returned, median lead time is 6 days, and complete early requests are delivered 87% of the time. Platform capacity is a real but secondary factor. Whether the SVP knowingly directed green-shifting is unproven. Preferred action: objective status criteria and an outcome-based bonus. Harmful actions: the requested transfer and SLAs, removing the SVP, and de-anonymizing survey comments.
